parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 172.16.2.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set protocols bgp group neighbor-172.16..command: set protocols bgp group neighbor-172.16.2.2 type external
set protocols bgp group neighbor-172.16.2.2 peer-as 300
set protocols bgp group neighbor-172.16.2.2 neighbor 172.16.2.2

set protocols bgp group neighbor-172.16..template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group neighbor-172.16..command: set protocols bgp group neighbor-172.16.2.2 family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group neighbor-172.16..explanation: 配置BGP组支持IPv4单播地址族。

set protocols bgp group neighbor-172.16..template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] family inet unicast no-readvertise
set protocols bgp group neighbor-172.16..command: set protocols bgp group neighbor-172.16.2.2 family inet unicast no-readvertise
set protocols bgp group neighbor-172.16..explanation: 配置BGP组在IPv4单播地址族下不重新通告路由。

set protocols bgp group neighbor-172.16..template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] family inet unicast network [parameter2]/[parameter3]
set protocols bgp group neighbor-172.16..command: set protocols bgp group neighbor-172.16.2.2 family inet unicast network 172.16.2.0/24
set protocols bgp group neighbor-172.16..explanation: 配置BGP组在IPv4单播地址族下通告的网络。

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: 网络地址的子网掩码位数。

set policy-options policy-statement bgp-.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] from protocol [parameter3]
set policy-options policy-statement bgp-.command: set policy-options policy-statement bgp-synchronization term 1 from protocol direct
set policy-options policy-statement bgp-.explanation: 配置策略语句的匹配条件为直接路由协议。

set policy-options policy-statement bgp-.command: set policy-options policy-statement bgp-synchronization term 1 then accept
set policy-options policy-statement bgp-.explanation: 配置策略语句的动作为接受。
